posts.text:
When someone's preferred candidate wins, elections are free and fair and democracy is good. 

When someone's preferred candidate loses, elections are rigged and democracy is a scam.

Happens every time.

Creating a life that you enjoy and are proud of is 100% up to you. I know that upsets some people because we live in an anti-accountability culture and it's easy to blame eveybody except yourself.
But it's up to you. Nobody else can do it for you.

I've been on social media for over 20 years...

I've seen a lot. 😂

My last public conversation with @ScottAdamsSays 

Uploading it here for posterity. Rest in peace. 💜

Video

Not everything needs to be 'content'. It's ok for some personal things to remain private.

We managed this for all human history until around 15 years ago.
I'm pretty sure that if I hadn't been going to the gym regularly for the past 20+ years, I'd be a significantly different (worse) person in all aspects.

Yeah...

I have political fatigue and I can't be alone in this regard.
